title: ESLint flat config that lints JavaScript with the recommended rules
intent: Set up ESLint for a JavaScript project and confirm it reports an unused variable.

check.run: (npx eslint bad.js > lint.txt || true) && grep -q "no-unused-vars" lint.txt && echo strue-ok

avoid.why: ESLint no longer reads .eslintrc files; configuration must be an eslint.config.js flat config.
